response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT raceId, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN points END) AS avg_points, AVG(CASE WHEN points > 6.0 THEN wins END) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings GROUP BY raceId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS avg_wins FROM per_race) SELECT p.raceId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.avg_wins AS wins_difference FROM per_race AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_difference IS NULL, wins_difference DESC, p.raceId LIMIT 10;
